_comment: Coverage baseline and minimum thresholds. Run scripts/test-coverage.* to measure current coverage, then compare against these thresholds. Fail the build if any metric drops below its minimum.
_notes: Thresholds are set at ~2-4 percentage points below baseline to allow normal fluctuation.
Raise thresholds as coverage improves; never lower them without justification.
To update baseline: run coverage scripts, edit this file with new baseline values.
CI should run: test-coverage -> parse result -> compare against thresholds -> fail if below.
